name: Aoyama-Itchome
tagline: Roppongi in 3 minutes and Shibuya in 6 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line and Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 13 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 6 minutes to Shibuya and 20 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. The station stands 32.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 14.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 32.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 20.1 m to 34.7 m, a difference of 14.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 10 clinics and 6 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at Sanno Medical Center, about 210 m away and 順和会山王病院, about 445 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line and Toei Oedo Line. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 73.

rentRange.note: One room ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1K ¥170,000 to ¥180,000, 1LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000 and 2LDK ¥500,000 to ¥510,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
